definitions.explanation: Electromagnetic radiation from the sun with wavelengths shorter than visible light. Can cause sunburn and skin damage.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{紫外線|しがいせん}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: UV rays are strong in summer.

examples.japanese: {紫外線|しがいせん}{対策|たいさく}として{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I applied sunscreen as a UV protection measure.

examples.japanese: {紫外線|しがいせん}は{肌|はだ}に{悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: UV rays have harmful effects on the skin.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{紫|むらさき}{外|がい} (beyond purple) + {線|せん} (rays) - named because these rays are beyond the violet end of the visible spectrum

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{紫外線|しがいせん}が{強|つよ}い (UV rays are strong)
・{紫外線|しがいせん}{対策|たいさく} (UV protection measures)
・{紫外線|しがいせん}カット (UV cut/blocking)
・{紫外線|しがいせん}を{浴|あ}びる (to be exposed to UV rays)
・{紫外線|しがいせん}から{守|まも}る (to protect from UV rays)

RELATED TERMS:
・UV - ユーブイ (commonly used abbreviation)
・{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め - sunscreen
・{日傘|ひがさ} - parasol/sun umbrella
・SPF - エスピーエフ (sun protection factor)
・{赤外線|せきがいせん} - infrared rays (opposite end of spectrum)
